import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    b = int(next(it))
    a = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(n)]

    costs = {}
    odd = 0
    even = 0
    for i in range(n - 1):
        if a[i] % 2 == 0:
            even += 1
        else:
            odd += 1
        if odd == even:
            cost = abs(a[i] - a[i + 1])
            costs[cost] = costs.get(cost, 0) + 1

    spent = 0
    cuts = 0
    for cost in sorted(costs.keys()):
        count = costs[cost]
        if spent > b:
            break
        if cost == 0:
            cuts += count
            continue
        can_take = (b - spent) // cost
        take = min(count, can_take)
        cuts += take
        spent += take * cost
        if take < count:
            break

    print(cuts)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
